items.title: SpaceX will build a second, $100B ‘Starbase’ spaceport in Louisiana
items.summary: The company says it will start construction in 2027 and that a Starship rocket could take flight as soon as 2029.

items.title: Your vote matters! Decide which Audience Choice sessions will make it to TechCrunch Founder Summit
items.summary: Each year, we get a huge influx of applicants to speak at TechCrunch’s events, and this year’s Founder Summit in Boston on November 4 will be no different!

items.title: Tonight marks your last chance to save up to $300 on a TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
items.summary: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

items.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
items.summary: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.

items.title: Waymo robotaxis are headed to Munich
items.summary: Germany's autonomous vehicle regulations have made it a hotspot for autonomous vehicle testing and eventual commercial robotaxi deployment.

items.title: Life360 expands pet tracking with new $8 scannable tags and zoomie alerts
items.summary: Life360’s new $7.99 scannable pet tags alert families when a lost pet is found and share its last known location, while new care-tracking features help households keep tabs on feeding, walks, medication, and more.

items.title: That fake Grand Theft Auto VI demo is actually just malware
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto fans, eager for news about one of the most anticipated video games of all time, appear especially vulnerable to this new cyberattack.

items.title: Pacific Fusion’s next fusion machine could clear a key hurdle to commercial power
items.summary: Fusion startup Pacific Fusion broke ground on a demonstration facility in New Mexico that it says will generate enough energy to power itself.

items.title: Gamma acquires Accel-backed design startup Lica
items.summary: Lica co-founders are going to work on Gamma's new research team.

items.title: Apple rescues Hide My Email feature from the privacy scrap heap
items.summary: Apple says it will no longer ditch using its icloud.com domain for hiding people's email addresses.

items.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
items.summary: Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.

items.title: Apple debuts its ‘most powerful chip ever’ in M5 Ultra and M6
items.summary: Apple unveils these new processors alongside an updated Mac Mini and Mac Studio.

items.title: Self-driving truck startup Gatik raises $200M following PepsiCo deal
items.summary: The funding, Gatik's largest so far, was led by Qatar Investment Authority and Koch Disruptive Technologies.

items.title: Apple’s latest Mac Mini runs on a new M6 chip, and starts at $899
items.summary: The base model of the Mac Mini comes with 256GB of storage, 16GB of RAM, and costs $899.

items.title: Andy Dunn’s startup Pie becomes less of an events app and more of a social network
items.summary: The social app founded by Bonobos co-founder Andy Dunn is expanding beyond events with new digital homes for groups to connect, organize, and make plans.

items.title: WhatsApp tightens account security with stronger two-step verification and more
items.summary: WhatsApp’s two-step verification previously relied on a six-digit PIN, but now users can choose a longer, alphanumeric password with special characters.

items.title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
items.summary: Now exiting stealth mode with a $26 million seed round, Keenable has been building a vast web search index for AI agents.

items.title: Uber launches live video streaming for teen accounts
items.summary: Uber said no one will be able to access the video once the ride ends.

items.title: Fiat Ventures combines venture and advisory divisions into new brand, raises $35M Fund II
items.summary: In an environment where emerging fund managers struggle to attract LP attention, FGV is betting that a different venture model can help it lure LPs.

items.title: Fitbit founders launch Luffu Link, an LTE health and safety band
items.summary: Luffu Link combines all-day health sensing, voice logging, location awareness, and the ability to get help from trusted contacts into a single device, all without needing a phone nearby.
